decisions.reason: The compact rotating-skip dumper kept its own page in both years, so the option is still being actively pursued and costs little to hold within the existing construction line.
The articulated dumper keeps its own page and fits Paus's core construction machinery, so it stays open while market feedback accumulates.
Its drop from a dedicated page to a mere mention suggests waning commitment, but this niche build-to-order rescue vehicle is cheap to keep, so the option stays open for now.
The compact telescopic loader is still shown prominently, and its uncertainty is not yet resolved, so keeping the option open is sensible.
The material lift is a long-standing rental favourite confirmed by a recent large order, so its value is realized and dropping it makes no sense.
The 1,000 operating hours in seven months show strong field performance, which justifies further commitment rather than abandonment.
